name: Autocomplete Deluxe
description: Enhanced autocomplete using Jquery UI autocomplete.
project_description:
This is an enhanced autocomplete element, that uses the jQuery UI autocomplete. It will also implement a widget for taxonomy.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Combo/Select box like selecting. 
 Select without entering something. 
 Widget for taxaonomy 
 Chosen like multiple selecting. 
 
 If you want to deny adding new terms, then checkout Chosen . It converts select boxes to autocomplete fields.

 Initial development by epiqo .

Active support and ongoing development by Mediacurrent and Vardot .

 Back to top 

 Drupal 7 version 
 The Drupal 7 version of the Autocomplete Deluxe module is not supported on drupal.org anymore. The D7Security group has taken over maintainership on Gitlab . Follow the D7Security user guide to continue receiving security update notifications for the Autocomplete Deluxe module.
